36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.

137864: Master is the main weapon of Fran. His personality is that of a father/guardian of sorts towards Fran, he takes care and protects her while also assisting her by providing his abilities and bonuses to Fran.
